body: Hardcoded thermal divisors in `temp_condition_factor()` (shrimp.rs:1595 and 1597): the constants 10.0 (cold divisor) and 8.0 (hot divisor) control how quickly molt success degrades at non-optimal temperatures but are not exposed as named parameters in `ShrimpRuntimeParams`. The same 8.0 divisor appears hardcoded in `update_molt_stress()` (shrimp.rs:492). Extract these into named parameters (e.g., `temp_condition_low_divisor_c`, `temp_condition_high_divisor_c`) in `ShrimpRuntimeParams` with serde defaults, so they are inspectable and tunable through species data files as required by the acceptance criteria.
